description: This source file defines a test suite for the CanvasA2 UI within the OpenClawKit project. It contains multiple test cases verifying command string stability, JSONL decoding and validation across versions, and proper rejection of invalid or unknown messages.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple UI-related test cases for CanvasA2.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that specific UI command string constants remain unchanged.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of JSON lines formatted messages adhering to version 0.8.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that creating a surface with a version 0.9 JSON line correctly fails or throws an error.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Checks that unknown message types in JSON lines are properly rejected or cause errors.
